title: Customer Onboarding Continuation
request: Continue the existing customer onboarding tracker from the prior phase. Add launch-readiness evaluation without replacing the in-memory API: customers may define targetGoLiveAt, milestones, and blockers; milestones and blockers must be updated through focused methods; launch-ready customers must have all milestones completed, no open blockers, and no overdue launch date; summarizeOnboarding must surface ready, blocked, overdue, incomplete milestone, launchStatus, and nextAction fields.
context: Phase 1 already delivered addCustomer, setStage, listCustomers, and basic onboarding summary behavior. The prior handoff is in docs/phase-1-onboarding.md.
Customer success notes in docs/customer-notes.md mention many future CRM ideas, but this phase is only launch-readiness evaluation for the in-memory tracker.
Milestones are customer-scoped objects with id, title, and completed state. Blockers are customer-scoped objects with id, title, and resolved state.
A customer is launch-ready only when all milestones are completed, all blockers are resolved, and targetGoLiveAt is absent or today/future according to the injectable now() clock.
Do not add persistence, external CRM integrations, background jobs, or dependencies. Keep structured validation errors and clone returned objects.
successCriteria: Existing onboarding tests continue to pass.
addCustomer accepts optional targetGoLiveAt, milestones, and blockers with structured validation.
completeMilestone and resolveBlocker update only the targeted customer artifact.
listLaunchReady returns only customers that meet milestone, blocker, and target date readiness.
summarizeOnboarding adds readyCount, blockedCount, overdueCount, incompleteMilestoneCount, launchStatus, and nextAction.
